title: Gen-Z Neon Sneaker Launch Reel
objective: Produce a high-energy 15-second vertical video reel for paid Instagram and TikTok ad campaigns launching our flagship liquid-tech running shoe.
idea_text: A fun 15-second reel for a sneaker launch aimed at Gen Z. Liquid neon morphs into the shoe sole, dynamic speed ramps, high energy music beat drop, crisp macro texture detail.
deliverables: 1x 9:16 hero 4K video reel, 2x short story cutdowns (6s each)

title: Biometric Crypto Security Animated Explainer
objective: Create a 60-second widescreen animated explainer video for our website hero banner explaining multi-sig biometric vault security.
idea_text: An engaging 60-second 16:9 3D animated explainer for NovaVault. Show a friendly character securing their digital assets with holographic biometric shields.
deliverables: 1x 16:9 Master 4K animation with sound design and AI narrator voice track

title: Festive Gold Jewellery Macro Visuals
objective: Develop a set of 1:1 square visual posts and macro motion loops for Diwali organic Instagram campaign.
idea_text: A festive gold jewellery campaign with warm candlelight, intricate temple gold filigree, subtle particle sparkles, and rich silk backgrounds.
deliverables: 5x high-res 1:1 square campaign stills, 2x 4-second looping ambient visualizers
